text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health;2. Abide by Chinese laws and regulations, respect Chinese customs and habits. Observe Chang’anUniversity discipline and school regulations;3. Education and age requirements of the applicants:(1) Those pursuing undergraduate majors must have a high school diploma and be under 25 years old;(2) Those pursuing a master's degree must have a bachelor's degree and be under 35 years old;(3) Those pursuing a doctorate must have a master's degree and be under the age of 40.4. Non-other scholarship recipients.
